scripts.secret:admin: pnpm --filter server exec wrangler secret put ADMIN_SECRET
scripts.secret:media: pnpm --filter server exec wrangler secret put MEDIA_SIGNING_SECRET
scripts.secret:play: pnpm --filter server exec wrangler secret put GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter server exec wrangler d1 migrations apply reelshort-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter server exec wrangler d1 migrations apply reelshort-db --remote
scripts.content:render: pnpm run content:frames && pnpm run content:generate
scripts.build:android: pnpm --filter mobile exec eas build --platform android --profile production
